The climate in Olympiada

Olympiada is about 0 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 32°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 4°C. Around 840 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 117 mm). The highest temperature in Olympiada in 2015–2024 was 39°C (3 August 2021) and the lowest −7°C (9 January 2019).

Best time to visit Olympiada

The most pleasant weather in Olympiada is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 9 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
